{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Group by species and compute mean flipper length
mean_flipper_by_species = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Extract the species with the highest mean and its value
species_with_highest_mean = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
mean_value = mean_flipper_by_species.max()

# Print only the required values for evidence
print(species_with_highest_mean)
print(mean_value)"}
